items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I had a studio because of Foster

ctx.x: I had a studio because of Foster, but Foster – the grounds of studios were owned by some white guy, and he had complained that white women – Foster was getting white women in this studio. So he went down. But until then, I’d stay with him, or I’d sleep in the lobby of the hotel, 53rd [Street] and Cottage Grove [Avenue], which I ended up writing music for that hotel, for its opening. That’s another funny story. The opening of this nightclub.
I know what you’re talking about. I can’t think of it. It’s famous.
